summary.goal: Define freeform Zod schemas for step-level Specification - implementation details keyed by domain (architecture, model, design, testing, security, or any custom domain)
summary.context: Specification is STEP-LEVEL (not plan-level). Each step can have its own micro-specifications detailing architecture decisions, design elements, test cases, and security requirements relevant to that step.
summary.model_decision: Hybrid model: Plan-level Understanding (ideation context) + Plan-level Context (decisions) + Step-level Specification (implementation details per step)
summary.freeform_rationale: Different steps need different domains. The Orchestrator is an LLM that can understand any JSON structure. Suggested domains and fields are documented for agent prompts but not enforced in Zod schemas.

StepSchema in step.ts updated to include optional specification field

design_spec.schema_approach: Freeform: z.record(z.string(), z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())). Suggested domains and fields below are documentation for agent prompts - NOT enforced by Zod validation.
